arxiv-1808-04065.title: Characterizing Regular Lagrangians by Lefschetz Fibration
arxiv-1808-04065.creator: Sauvik Mukherjee
arxiv-1808-04065.description: Abstract . In [ 3 ] Eliashberg, Ganatra and Lazarev have introduced the notion of Regular Lagrangians in Weinstein cobordisms and also predicted that Regular Lagrangians can be characterized by the existence of Weinstein Lefschetz Fibrations . In this paper we present a proof of this fact with an hypothesis. 1.

arxiv-2102-13153.title: Gas phase Elemental abundances in Molecular cloudS (GEMS)
arxiv-2102-13153.creator: M. Rodríguez-Baras, A. Fuente, P. Riviére-Marichalar D. Navarro-Almaida, P. Caselli, M. Gerin, C. Kramer, E. Roueff, V. Wakelam, G. Esplugues, S. García-Burillo, R. Le Gal, S. Spezzano, T. Alonso-Albi, R. Bachiller, S. Cazaux, B. Commercon, J. R. Goicoechea, J. C. Loison, S. P. Treviño-Morales, O. R
arxiv-2102-13153.description: Abstract Gas phase Elemental abundances in Molecular CloudS (GEMS) is an IRAM 30m Large Program designed to provide estimates of the S, C, N, and O depletions and gas ionization degree, X(e - ), in a selected set of star-forming filaments of Taurus, Perseus, and Orion.

arxiv-2304-00023.title: Study of the Bound State, Electron-Detachment Energy and Reactivity of Hydride Ion using Variational Quantum Eigensolver
arxiv-2304-00023.creator: Abdul Kalam, Ashok Kumar, Prasanta K. Panigrahi
arxiv-2304-00023.description: Abstract The accurate prediction and understanding of molecular energy and chemical reactivity are fundamental pursuits in the field of molecular quantum chemistry. With the limitations of the current noisy intermediate-scale quantum computer (NISQ) era, the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithm offers a promising approach to efficiently estimate the stable-energy state of a given molecule.

arxiv-2307-10285.title: Quantum Query Complexity of Boolean Functions under Indefinite Causal Order
arxiv-2307-10285.creator: Alastair A. Abbott, Mehdi Mhalla, Pierre Pocreau
arxiv-2307-10285.description: Abstract The standard model of quantum circuits assumes operations are applied in a fixed sequential “causal” order. In recent years, the possibility of relaxing this constraint to obtain causally indefinite computations has received significant attention. The quantum switch, for example, uses a quantum system to coherently control the order of operations.

arxiv-2310-18829.title: Abundant radiation of soft photons: a puzzle lasting four decades
arxiv-2310-18829.creator: Iván Schmidt
arxiv-2310-18829.description: Abstract The observed enhancement of low- k T k_{T} photons in comparison with incorrect calculations, should not be treated as a puzzle. The paper by Low considered a large rapidity gap process of diffractive excitation of a hadron, h → h + γ h\to h+\gamma , rather than multiple hadron production spanning all over the rapidity interval between colliding hadrons.

arxiv-2311-07275.title: Metallic conductivity on Na-deficient structural domain walls in the spin-orbit Mott insulator Na 2 IrO 3
arxiv-2311-07275.creator: Franziska A. Breitner, Julian Kaiser, Anton Jesche, Philipp Gegenwart
arxiv-2311-07275.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Franziska A. Breitner, Julian Kaiser, Anton Jesche, Philipp Gegenwart. Honeycomb Na 2 IrO 3 is a prototype spin-orbit Mott insulator and Kitaev magnet. We report a combined structural and electrical resistivity study of Na 2 IrO 3 single crystals. Laue back-scattering diffraction indicates twinning with ± 120 ∘ \pm 120^{\circ} rotation around the c ∗ c^{*} -axis while scanning electron microscopy displays nanothin lines parallel to all three b-axis orientations of twin domains.

arxiv-2402-03153.title: Learning solutions of parametric Navier-Stokes with physics-informed neural networks
arxiv-2402-03153.creator: Mahdi Naderibeni, Marcel J.T. Reinders, Liang Wu, David M.J. Tax
arxiv-2402-03153.description: Abstract We leverage Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to learn solution functions of parametric Navier-Stokes Equations (NSE). Our proposed approach results in a feasible optimization problem setup that bypasses PINNs’ limitations in converging to solutions of highly nonlinear parametric-PDEs like NSE.

arxiv-2408-03807.title: Navigating the Human Maze: Real-Time Robot Pathfinding with Generative Imitation Learning
arxiv-2408-03807.creator: Martin Moder, Stephen Adhisaputra, Josef Pauli
arxiv-2408-03807.description: Abstract This paper addresses navigation in crowded environments by integrating goal-conditioned generative models with Sampling-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC). We introduce goal-conditioned autoregressive models to generate crowd behaviors, capturing intricate interactions among individuals. The model processes potential robot trajectory samples and predicts the reactions of surrounding individuals, enabling proactive robotic navigation in complex scenarios.

arxiv-2410-01262.title: Improving Fine-Grained Control via Aggregation of Multiple Diffusion Models
arxiv-2410-01262.creator: Conghan Yue, Zhengwei Peng, Shiyan Du, Zhi Ji, Chuangjian Cai, Le Wan, Dongyu Zhang
arxiv-2410-01262.description: Abstract While many diffusion models perform well when controlling particular aspects such as style, character, and interaction, they struggle with fine-grained control due to dataset limitations and intricate model architecture design. This paper introduces a novel training-free algorithm for fine-grained generation, called Aggregation of Multiple Diffusion Models (AMDM).

arxiv-2508-21525.title: The Moffatt-Pukhnachev flow: a new twist on an old problem.
arxiv-2508-21525.creator: Antonio J. Bárcenas-Luque, Mark G. Blyth
arxiv-2508-21525.description: Abstract The flow of a thin viscous film on the outside of a horizontal circular cylinder, whose angular velocity consists of a steady part and an oscillatory part, is investigated. In the absence of the oscillatory component the problem reduces to that originally studied by Moffatt [ 1 ] and Pukhnachev [ 2 ] . Surface tension is neglected.

arxiv-2510-08909.title: Gravity-Induced Modulation of Negative Differential Thermal Resistance in Fluids
arxiv-2510-08909.creator: Qiyuan Zhang 1, Juncheng Guo 1, Juchang Zou 1, Rongxiang Luo 1,2
arxiv-2510-08909.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qiyuan Zhang 1, Juncheng Guo 1, Juchang Zou 1, Rongxiang Luo 1,2. We investigate how gravity influences negative differential thermal resistance (NDTR) in fluids modeled by multiparticle collision dynamics. In the integrable case, we derive the heat flux formula for the system exhibiting the NDTR effect, and show that by introducing a gravity along the direction of the thermodynamic force, the temperature difference required for the occurrence of NDTR can be greatly reduced.

arxiv-2512-02488.title: Translational symmetry breaking in the electronic nematic phase of BaFe 2 As 2
arxiv-2512-02488.creator: K. Koshiishi, L. Liu, K. Okazaki, H. Suzuki, J. Xu, M. Horio, H. Kumigashira, K. Ono, M. Nakajima, S. Ishida, K. Kihou, C. H. Lee, A. Iyo, H. Eisaki, S. Uchida, A. Fujimori
arxiv-2512-02488.description: Abstract The microscopic origin of the nematicity, namely, four-fold rotational symmetry breaking in iron-based superconductors has been controversial since its discovery. In particular, its relationship with the stripe-type spin-density-wave order and the orthorhombic lattice distortion in the antiferromagnetic orthorhombic (AFO) phase, which exists at temperatures below the electronic nematic phase, has been highly debated.

arxiv-2602-04653.title: Inference-Time Backdoors via Hidden Instructions in LLM Chat Templates
arxiv-2602-04653.creator: Ariel Fogel * † Omer Hofman * ‡ ariel@pillar.security omer.hofman@fujitsu.com Eilon Cohen † Roman Vainshtein ‡ eilon@pillar.security roman.vainshtein@fujitsu.com
arxiv-2602-04653.description: Abstract Open-weight language models are increasingly used in production settings, raising new security challenges. One prominent threat in this context is backdoor attacks, in which adversaries embed hidden behaviors in language models that activate under specific conditions. Previous work has assumed that adversaries have access to training pipelines or deployment infrastructure.

arxiv-2604-22534.title: FeatEHR-LLM: Leveraging Large Language Models for Feature Engineering in Electronic Health Records
arxiv-2604-22534.creator: Hojjat Karami, David Atienza, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Anisoara Ionescu

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andreas-rass.creator: Friedrich Lauchert
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-andreas-rass.description: Article 'Andreas Rass' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10525736.title: The miR-214-5p/Lactoferrin/miR-224-5p/ADAM17 Axis Is Involved in Goat Mammary Epithelial Cells’ Immune Regulation
pmc-10525736.creator: Shilong Pang, Yuexin Shao, Yan Yu, Kela Sha, Yanting Jiang, Xian Zhang, Yuling Zhong, Huaiping Shi, Weijuan Li, Maria Luisa Dettori, Giuseppe Moniell
pmc-10525736.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryLactoferrin (LF) is considered to be an important active protein in goat milk, and it plays an important role in immunity. In this study, we tried to find factors affecting the expression of lactoferrin.

pmc-10693545.title: Single-crystal ZrCo nanoparticle for advanced hydrogen and H-isotope storage
pmc-10693545.creator: Zhenyang Li, Shiyuan Liu, Yanhui Pu, Gang Huang, Yingbo Yuan, Ruiqi Zhu, Xufeng Li, Chunyan Chen, Gao Deng, Haihan Zou, Peng Yi, Ming Fang, Xin Sun, Junzhe He, He Cai, Jiaxiang Shang, Xiaofang Liu, Ronghai Yu, Jianglan Shui
pmc-10693545.description: Hydrogen-isotope storage materials are essential for the controlled nuclear fusion. However, the currently used smelting-ZrCo alloy suffers from rapid degradation of performance due to severe disproportionation. Here, we reveal a defect-derived disproportionation mechanism and report a nano-single-crystal strategy to solve ZrCo’s problems.

pmc-11480296.title: Pharmacodynamic Response to Deucravacitinib, an Oral, Selective, Allosteric TYK2 Inhibitor, in a Global, Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Psoriasis Trial
pmc-11480296.creator: Ian M Catlett, Lu Gao, Yanhua Hu, Subhashis Banerjee, James G Krueger
pmc-11480296.description: BackgroundPsoriasis, a chronic, immune-mediated, inflammatory disease, affects 2‒3% of the population. Tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) mediates cytokine signaling involved in adaptive [interleukin (IL)-12, IL-23] and innate (type-I interferons) immune responses; IL-23–driven T-helper (Th)17 pathways play a key role in chronic inflammation in psoriasis.

pmc-11600184.title: Efficient Biomimetic Total Synthesis, Characterization, and Antioxidant Activity of Ommatins
pmc-11600184.creator: Lili Huang, Taehwan Kim, Olivia J. Armendarez, Leila F. Deravi, Prakash T. Parvatkar, Roman Manetsch
pmc-11600184.description: Ommatins, natural colorants found in cephalopods and arthropods, are biosynthesized from tryptophan with uncyclized xanthommatin (Uc-Xa) as the key biosynthetic precursor. These pigments change color under oxidative or reductive conditions. Xanthommatin (Xa) and dihydro-xanthommatin (H2-Xa), as well as decarboxylated xanthommatin (Dc-Xa) and decarboxylated-dihydro-xanthommatin (Dc-H2-Xa), are some of the most common and well-studied ommatins.

pmc-11696389.title: Supramolecular Control of the Photoisomerization of a Coumarin-Based Photoswitch
pmc-11696389.creator: Etelka Kiss, Dávid Mester, Márton Bojtár, Zsombor Miskolczy, László Biczók, Dóra Hessz, Mihály Kállay, Miklós Kubinyi
pmc-11696389.description: The complex formation of the cationic stilbene-type photoswitch CP with the anionic macrocycles carboxylato-pillar[5]arene (WP5) and carboxylato-pillar[6]arene (WP6) has been investigated in aqueous solution by optical spectroscopic, NMR and isothermal calorimetric experiments and theoretical calculations. Subsequently, the photoisomerization reactions of the supramolecular complexes formed have been studied.

pmc-12533126.title: Bone regeneration induced by a novel quercetin/a-CSH/n-HA composite in critical size tibia defect of rats with osteoporosis
pmc-12533126.creator: Mingliang Ren, Yunjie Yang, Kun Chen, Gang Mei, Wei Zeng, Jinfu Wei, Qian Chen
pmc-12533126.description: Bone defects in the presence of osteoporosis present a significant clinical challenge. To address this, we sought to engineer a novel artificial bone substitute exhibiting excellent biocompatibility, osteoconductivity, osteoinduction, anti-aging, and anti-osteoporotic capabilities for enhanced bone regeneration. This project introduces an innovative Q-α-CSH/n-HA composite, synthesized by incorporating Quercetin into alpha-calcium sulfate hemihydrate/nano-hydroxyapatite (α-CSH/n-HA).

pmc-12559166.title: Computation of simple invariant solutions in fluid turbulence with the aid of deep learning
pmc-12559166.creator: Jacob Page
pmc-12559166.description: The dynamical systems view of a turbulent fluid flow provides a tantalizing connection between the self-sustaining nonlinear mechanics of turbulence and its more well-known statistical properties, and promises to open up new avenues in our ability to understand, predict and control complex fluid motion.

pmc-12650058.title: Invasion Mechanisms of the Alien Plant Datura stramonium in Xizang: Insights from Genetic Differentiation, Allelopathy, and Ecological Niche Analysis
pmc-12650058.creator: Yonghao Chen, Zhefei Zeng, Qiong La, Junwei Wang, Miki Daisuke
pmc-12650058.description: Simple SummaryDatura stramonium, a poisonous plant originally from Mexico, is spreading quickly in parts of China, including Tibet, and can crowd out local plants. We aim to understand why it is so successful so that better control plans can be made.

pmc-13130180.title: Speciation and hydration forces in sodium carbonate/bicarbonate aqueous solutions nanoconfined between mica sheets
pmc-13130180.creator: Daria Turculet, Shurui Miao, Kieran J. Agg, Susan Perkin
pmc-13130180.description: The equilibrium between hydrated and hydrolysed forms of CO2 in water is central to a multitude of processes in geology, oceanography and biology. Chemistry of the carbonate system is well understood in bulk solution, however processes such as mineral weathering and biomineralisation frequently occur in nano-confined spaces where carbonate chemistry is less explored.

pmc-13273412.title: Efficacy and safety of pyrimidine nucleos(t)ide therapy in thymidine kinase 2 deficiency
pmc-13273412.creator: Michio Hirano, Caterina Garone, Richard Haas, Carmen Paradas, Fernando Scaglia, Irene Rebollo Mesa, Carl Chiang, Anny-Odile Colson, Susan VanMeter, Cristina Domínguez-González
pmc-13273412.description: Thymidine kinase 2 deficiency (TK2d) (MIM 609560) is an ultra-rare, autosomal recessive mitochondrial myopathy caused by TK2 variants, leading to mitochondrial DNA depletion and/or multiple deletions. People with thymidine kinase 2 deficiency experience progressive myopathy, bulbar weakness and respiratory insufficiency, often losing the ability to walk, eat and breathe independently.

pmc-13295346.title: Cyanoacrylate Glue Insertion Versus Seton Placement in the Management of Trans-sphincteric Anal Fistula: A Prospective Comparative Study
pmc-13295346.creator: Sarana Venkata Anuja, Anand Kannan, Sivaraja P.K., Arulappan Thangasamy
pmc-13295346.description: Background: Anal fistula is a common perianal condition associated with significant morbidity, recurrence, and risk of incontinence. Traditional surgical techniques such as seton placement are effective but are often associated with pain, prolonged healing time, and extended hospitalisation. Cyanoacrylate glue has emerged as a minimally invasive sphincter-preserving alternative.

pmc-13473160.title: In-hospital inflammatory-nutritional-renal trajectory phenotypes and 90-day readmission or mortality in patients with acute decompensated heart failure: a retrospective cohort study
